items.title: Lily Quest - 鳴潮が再び自分自身を上回りました!!史上最高の作品のひとつ。
items.sourceType: 海外Redditフォーラム 鳴潮総合 (公式純リンクRSS)
items.scriptOutline:
【動画・記事の完全論説・網羅的詳細】：
No spoilers here. Some things I wanted to share because I don't know anyone in real life who plays this game and this is the only place where I can share. hehe. I really loved the writing here. It was spacious and they gave it full scope for emotions to flow. the pauses felt natural and the MUSIC!! Oh the Somnoire music, already nostalgic at this point. I really loved it. Although I had already made up my mind to pull for Lily before this patch based on the teasers, but this cemented it. She is a brave soul and you guys need to play this quest. Take the weekend, it is well worth it. It felt like a film. The minigames were minimal. You can just sit back and relax and watch it. Also, the colours have gotten better for this game, right (since the Simulacrum nexus map)? And on Lily's aesthetic -- the violet and black, it felt so powerful. her voice actress (EN) has done a great job.  I've seen people call it a filler patch which boggles my mind. It's one of those quests which I can watch the actually remember why I started playing this game in the first place. I remember feeling in Aemeth, Danya Phrolova Camellya Iuno Suoming quests (these are my favourites among others). Who cares if it important to the "lore" of the game or not. I am not even sure if I understand the lore anymore. Just give me tribal emotions. I got her in 140 pulls and I can sit silent now.  Alright before I spoil anything, bye!    submitted by    /u/Low_Application_421   [link]   [個のコメント
